title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
abstract: arXiv:2611.25380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Domain specialization of LLM agents is usually framed as a weight-update problem: collect trajectories, run reinforcement learning (RL) or supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and deploy a new checkpoint. We study a complementary axis: evolving the \textbf{agent harness}---the system prompt, tool schemas, skill library, and planning scaffolding---while keeping the policy frozen. We cast harness evolution as an RL-style outer loop and instantiate it with GEPA, a reflective evolutionary optimizer. The resulting harness adapters require no GPU training, are loadable per vertical domain, and compose with weight-based RL. Experiments with Codev, a Claude Code-style coding agent, on SWE-bench Verified, OfficeBench, and Terminal-Bench show a consistent pattern: weight updates give the strongest single-path gains, harness evolution recovers most of those gains at a small fraction of the compute, and combining both paths is best overall. translated_title: 超越权重更新：面向领域专精化的智能体框架演化
translated_abstract: LLM 智能体的领域专精化通常被构建为一个权重更新问题：收集轨迹数据、运行强化学习（RL）或监督微调（SFT），然后部署新的模型检查点。我们研究了一个互补的维度：在保持策略冻结的同时，演化“智能体框架”——即系统提示词、工具模式、技能库和规划脚手架。我们将框架演化建模为一个 RL 式的外层循环，并使用 GEPA（一种反思式进化优化器）来实例化。由此得到的框架适配器无需 GPU 训练，可以按垂直领域加载，并能与基于权重的 RL 组合使用。在 Codev（一个类似 Claude Code 的编程智能体）上针对 SWE-bench Verified、OfficeBench 和 Terminal-Bench 的实验显示出一致的模式：权重更新带来最强的单一路径增益，框架演化以极小的计算成本恢复了其中大部分增益，而将两条路径结合则整体效果最佳。
tldr: 该论文提出在冻结模型权重的前提下，将智能体框架（系统提示词、工具模式、技能库与规划脚手架）的演化作为权重更新之外的领域专精化路径，能以极小的计算成本恢复大部分 RL 微调收益，且与权重级 RL 相结合时效果最佳。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes evolving the agent harness (system prompt, tool schemas, skill library, and planning scaffolding) with a frozen policy as a compute-efficient complement to weight updates for LLM agent domain specialization, recovering most RL gains at a fraction of the cost, with the best results achieved by combining both approaches.
